issue_context.title: BUG: astype ignore errors not working for categorical/StringArray
issue_context.body:
- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the latest version of pandas.

- [ ] (optional) I have confirmed this bug exists on the master branch of pandas.

---

#### Problem description

It seems to be ignoring `errors='ignore'` kwarg. The behavior in 0.25.3 is expected.

#### Code Sample, a copy-pastable example

```python
import pandas as pd
pd.__version__
# '1.0.5'

pd.Series(pd.Categorical(['A', 'B'])).astype(float, errors='ignore')
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ValueError                                Traceback (most recent call last)
# <ipython-input-4-3d39cd9c1cdd> in <module>
# ----> 1 pd.Series(pd.Categorical(['A', 'B'])).astype(float, errors='ignore')
#
# ...
# ValueError: could not convert string to float: 'A'
```


#### Expected Output


```python
import pandas as pd
pd.__version__
# '0.25.3'

pd.Series(pd.Categorical(['A', 'B'])).astype(float, errors='ignore')
# 0    A
# 1    B
# dtype: category
# Categories (2, object): [A, B]
```
